perfil: Though somewhat shy, she has formidable strength. It's hard to imagine that her heavy gauntlets are in fact "restraints" for her natural immense power.

habilidades.b: Punches rapidly, dealing multiple phases of DMG. Casts Fiery Punches when ammo is available.

tpl.s: Punches and kicks the target. Strike 1: ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Strike 2: ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Strike 3: ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Strike 4: ⟦3⟧ of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Strike 5: ⟦4⟧ of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Casts Fiery Punches when ammo is available. Strike 1: ⟦5⟧ of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Strike 2: ⟦6⟧ of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Strike 3: ⟦7⟧ of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Blitz Combo and Fiery Punches deal ⟦8⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Auto Attack DMG to other targets behind the target hit by them.

builds.d: A build that increases Magazine Capacity and strikes enemies with enhanced Auto Attacks.
A build that instantly dumps Ammo, dealing massive DMG with high-frequency Auto Attacks.

l.b: When casting the Main Skill, deals additional DMG and increases Magazine Capacity.
l.s:
Fuyuka's Magazine now holds 9 ammo.
When casting Ignis Infusion (Main Skill), deals an additional ⟦0⟧ as Ignis Skill DMG.

l.b: Each strike of Fiery Punches deals additional DMG.
l.s: Fiery Punches deal additional damage.  Strike 1: ⟦0⟧ as Ignis Auto Attack DMG.  Strike 2: ⟦1⟧ as Ignis Auto Attack DMG.  Strike 3: ⟦2⟧ as Ignis Auto Attack DMG.

l.b: The third strike of Fiery Punches deals additional DMG.
l.s: The third strike of Fiery Punches deals an additional ⟦0⟧ as AoE Ignis Auto Attack DMG.

l.b: Fiery Punches and Magma Burst deals increased Auto Attack DMG and can trigger ⟨Ignis Mark⟩.
l.s: Increases the Auto Attack DMG dealt by Fiery Punches and Magma Burst by ⟦0⟧, and allows them to trigger ⟨Ignis Mark⟩.

l.b: When Fuyuka strikes with Fiery Punches, increases Fiery Punches' Auto Attack DMG.
l.s: When Fuyuka strikes with Fiery Punches, increases Fiery Punches' Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 3s, up to 8 stacks. All stacks are removed when Fuyuka casts Ignis Infusion (Main Skill).

l.b: When the Main Skill hits a target, inflicts Paw Print.  When Fuyuka deals Auto Attack DMG to a target inflicted with Paw Print, deals additional damage.
l.s: When Ignis Infusion (Main Skill) hits a target, inflicts Paw Print for 15s.  When Fuyuka deals Auto Attack DMG to a target inflicted with Paw Print, deals an additional ⟦0⟧ as Ignis Skill DMG.  This effect can trigger ⟨Ignis Mark⟩.

l.b: After Fuyuka casts the Main Skill, her next Fiery Punches are enhanced into Magma Burst.
l.s: After Fuyuka casts Ignis Infusion (Main Skill), her next Fiery Punches are enhanced into Magma Burst, consuming 3 ammo at once to deal ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Ignis Auto Attack DMG. When Fuyuka's magazine is empty, increases her ATK SPD by ⟦2⟧.

l.b: Fuyuka's fourth attack on the same target deals additional DMG.
l.s: Every time Fuyuka deals DMG to a target 4 times, she launches an additional attack on the same target, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Ignis Skill DMG. After this effect triggers, it has a 1.5s cooldown before it can stack again.

l.b: After casting the Main Skill, increases Fuyuka's ATK SPD and Skill DMG.
l.s: After casting Ignis Infusion (Main Skill), increases Fuyuka's ATK SPD by 20% and her Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 8s.

l.b: Every few seconds, increases the Auto Attack DMG of Fiery Punches and Magma Burst.
l.s: Every 8s, increases the Auto Attack DMG of the next Fiery Punches and Magma Burst by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases Fuyuka's Ignis DMG to targets with low HP.
l.s: Increases Fuyuka's Ignis DMG to targets at less than 70% HP by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When Fuyuka squads up with Ignis Trekkers only, increases her ATK.
l.s: When Fuyuka squads up with Ignis Trekkers only, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When Fuyuka lands a Crit Hit on an elite or higher-tier target, increases ATK.
l.s: When Fuyuka lands a Crit Hit on an elite or higher-tier target, increases ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 8s, up to 5 stacks.

l.b: Each time the Ultimate triggers an ⟨Ignis Mark⟩, increases Fuyuka's ATK during this Ultimate.
l.s: When Blaze Unsealed (Ultimate) triggers an ⟨Ignis Mark⟩, increases Fuyuka's ATK by ⟦0⟧ during this Ultimate, up to 5 stacks.

l.b: The Ultimate delivers more punches. Also increases Fuyuka's Ultimate DMG.
l.s: Blaze Unsealed (Ultimate) delivers 4 additional punches. Also increases Fuyuka's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When casting the Ultimate, increases Fuyuka's Ultimate DMG. This buff decays over time.
l.s: When Fuyuka casts Blaze Unsealed (Ultimate), she gains 6 stacks of buff, each increasing her Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧, and then removes 1 stack of the buff per second.

builds.d: A build that gathers power to deal massive single-target DMG.
A build that deals rapid, multi-hit DMG to targets over time.

l.b: Combines the multiple strikes of the Support Skill into a single massive blow.
l.s: Eruption Punch (Support Skill) now delivers a single massive blow, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Ignis Skill DMG to nearby targets and stunning them for ⟦1⟧s. It also deals ⟦2⟧ as Ignis Skill DMG to targets in a large area.

l.b: When the Support Skill ends, Fuyuka deals additional DMG to nearby targets.
l.s: When Eruption Punch (Support Skill) ends, Fuyuka strikes the nearby targets one more time, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Ignis Skill DMG.

l.b: When Fuyuka casts the Support Skill, she charges at the target, dealing additional DMG.
l.s: When Fuyuka casts Eruption Punch (Support Skill), she charges at the target, dealing an additional ⟦0⟧ as Ignis Skill DMG.

l.b: When casting the Support Skill, increases Fuyuka's Ignis DMG.
l.s: When casting Eruption Punch (Support Skill), increases Fuyuka's Ignis DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 3s.

l.b: When Fuyuka is not present, for every few seconds, increases the Skill DMG of the next Support Skill.
l.s: After Fuyuka casts her Eruption Punch (Support Skill) or Blaze Unsealed (Ultimate) and leaves the battlefield, increases the Skill DMG of the next Eruption Punch (Support Skill) by ⟦0⟧ every second, up to 9 stacks. Resets after casting the Support Skill.

l.b: Increases the DMG of the Support Skill. Also increases the its Attack Range and duration.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG of Eruption Punch (Support Skill) by ⟦0⟧ and its Attack Range by ⟦1⟧. Also increases the shockwave's duration by ⟦2⟧.

l.b: Increases the Support Skill's Ignis DMG over time.
l.s: While Eruption Punch (Support Skill) is active, increases the Ignis DMG by ⟦0⟧ every 0.5s.

l.b: When the Support Skill deals DMG, deals additional DMG.
l.s: When Eruption Punch (Support Skill) deals damage, deals an additional ⟦0⟧ as Ignis Skill DMG.

l.b: Reduces the Support Skill's Attack Interval and increases its DMG.
l.s: Reduces Eruption Punch (Support Skill)'s Attack Interval by 40% and increases its Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: While the Support Skill is active, increases Fuyuka's Ignis DMG over time.
l.s: While Eruption Punch (Support Skill) is active, increases Fuyuka's Ignis DMG by ⟦0⟧ every sec, stacking up to 4 times.

l.b: Increases Ignis Trekkers' Crit DMG.
l.s: Increases Ignis Trekkers' Crit DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases Fuyuka's Ignis DMG against elite or higher-tier targets.
l.s: Increases Fuyuka's Ignis DMG by ⟦0⟧ against elite or higher-tier targets.

l.b: When the Support Skill kills a target, increases Fuyuka's ATK.
l.s: When Eruption Punch (Support Skill) kills a target, increases Fuyuka's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 10s, up to 4 stacks.

l.b: Each time the Ultimate triggers an ⟨Ignis Mark⟩, increases Fuyuka's ATK during this Ultimate.
l.s: When Blaze Unsealed (Ultimate) triggers an ⟨Ignis Mark⟩, increases Fuyuka's ATK by ⟦0⟧ during this Ultimate, up to 5 stacks.

l.b: The Ultimate delivers more punches. Also increases Fuyuka's Ultimate DMG.
l.s: Blaze Unsealed (Ultimate) delivers 4 additional punches. Also increases Fuyuka's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When casting the Ultimate, increases Fuyuka's Ultimate DMG. This buff decays over time.
l.s: When Fuyuka casts Blaze Unsealed (Ultimate), she gains 6 stacks of buff, each increasing her Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧, and then removes 1 stack of the buff per second.
